Findings.Title: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Anomaly Detection
Findings.Description: Advanced practice: Monitor cross-domain flows for quantum-vulnerable cryptography.
Findings.Expected: Active monitoring of cryptographic OIDs for legacy RSA/ECC fallback.
Findings.Actual: Khepra DAG sentinel verified cryptographically active.

Findings.Title: Limit system access to authorized users
Findings.Description: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, or devices (including other information systems)
Findings.Expected: Only authorized users have system access
Findings.Actual: User accounts audited, unauthorized accounts disabled

Findings.Title: Create and retain system audit logs
Findings.Description: Create, protect, and retain information system audit records to the extent needed to enable monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful, unauthorized, or inappropriate information system activity
Findings.Expected: Audit logs created, protected, and retained
Findings.Actual: Auditd configured with log retention and protection

Findings.Title: Identify information system users
Findings.Description: Identify information system users, processes acting on behalf of users, or devices
Findings.Actual: All users have unique UIDs, shared accounts prohibited

Findings.Title: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography
Findings.Description: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI
Findings.Actual: FIPS mode not enabled

Findings.Title: Access Control Policy and Procedures
Findings.Description: Organization must develop, document, and disseminate access control policy
Findings.Actual: Requires organizational documentation review
Findings.Remediation: Develop and document access control policy per NIST 800-53 AC-1

Findings.Title: Event Logging
Findings.Expected: Auditd configured to log security events
Findings.Actual: Auditd active and logging enabled

Findings.Title: Configuration Settings
Findings.Description: System must implement security configuration settings
Findings.Actual: RHEL 9 STIG baseline applied

Findings.Title: Authenticator Management
Findings.Description: System must manage authenticators (passwords, keys, tokens)
Findings.Expected: PAM configured for strong password policy
Findings.Actual: PAM enforces password complexity and history

Findings.Title: Cryptographic Protection
Findings.Expected: FIPS mode enabled, post-quantum algorithms available
Findings.Actual: FIPS mode disabled, legacy cryptography in use
Findings.Remediation: Enable FIPS mode and deploy PQC algorithms (Dilithium3, Kyber1024)

Findings.Title: TLS post-quantum readiness
Findings.Description: Assess TLS configuration for post-quantum algorithm support
Findings.Expected: TLS 1.3 with hybrid PQC key exchange (X25519Kyber768)
Findings.Actual: TLS 1.2/1.3 with classical key exchange only
Findings.Remediation: Upgrade to TLS 1.3 with PQC hybrid mode, deploy Kyber-aware TLS libraries

Findings.Title: SSH post-quantum readiness
Findings.Description: Assess SSH configuration for post-quantum algorithm support
Findings.Expected: SSH with PQC key exchange and host keys (sntrup761, Dilithium)
Findings.Actual: SSH with classical algorithms only (RSA, ECDSA, Ed25519)
Findings.Remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to version supporting PQC KEX (sntrup761x25519-sha512@openssh.com)

Findings.Title: X.509 certificate post-quantum readiness
Findings.Description: Assess X.509 certificates for post-quantum signatures
Findings.Expected: Certificates signed with PQC algorithms (Dilithium3, SPHINCS+)
Findings.Actual: Certificates use RSA/ECDSA signatures only
Findings.Remediation: Deploy hybrid certificates (RSA+Dilithium3) or pure PQC certificates

Findings.Title: VPN post-quantum readiness
Findings.Description: Assess VPN (IPsec/IKEv2) for post-quantum algorithm support
Findings.Expected: IPsec with PQC key exchange (IKEv2 with Kyber)
Findings.Actual: IPsec with classical DH/ECDH key exchange
Findings.Remediation: Upgrade VPN to support PQC KEMs (Kyber1024) for IKEv2

Findings.Title: Code signing post-quantum readiness
Findings.Description: Assess code signing for post-quantum signatures
Findings.Actual: Software signed with RSA/ECDSA only
Findings.Remediation: Implement PQC code signing (Dilithium3) for software distribution
